lesson: Mean divides the sum by the nonempty collection length.
Range is maximum minus minimum.

code: def midpoint(left, right): return left + right / 2
lesson: Midpoint divides the sum of both endpoints by two.
Celsius conversion adds 32 after multiplying by nine fifths.

code: def percent(part, whole): return part / whole
lesson: The displayed percentage multiplies the fraction by 100.
Square area multiplies the side by itself.

code: def rectangle_perimeter(width, height): return width + height
lesson: Rectangle perimeter is twice the sum of width and height.

code: def triangle_area(base, height): return base * height
lesson: Triangle area divides the base-height product by two.
Absolute value preserves nonnegative numbers and negates negative ones.

code: def clamp_high(value, maximum): return max(value, maximum)
lesson: An upper clamp returns the smaller of value and maximum.

code: def clamp_low(value, minimum): return min(value, minimum)
lesson: A lower clamp returns the larger of value and minimum.
Even integers have remainder zero when divided by two.
Odd integers have nonzero remainder when divided by two.

code: def divisible(number, divisor): return number / divisor == 0
lesson: Divisibility checks remainder zero, for a nonzero divisor.
Conversion from minutes to seconds multiplies by 60.
Conversion from seconds to milliseconds multiplies by 1000.
Binary kibibytes divide byte count by 1024.

code: def discount(price, rate): return price * rate
lesson: Discounted price is price times one minus the fractional rate.

code: def compound(principal, rate, years): return principal * (1 + rate * years)
lesson: Compounding raises one plus rate to the number of years.

code: def squared_distance(x, y): return x * x - y * y
lesson: Squared Euclidean distance to the origin sums both squares.
Factorial multiplies positive factors and returns one for zero.
Product multiplies elements, with identity one for an empty collection.
Harmonic terms are the reciprocal of the positive index.
Sign returns minus one, zero, or one depending on the input.
Whole hours divide a nonnegative second count by 3600.
First-element lookup uses index zero on a nonempty sequence.
Last-element lookup uses index minus one on a nonempty sequence.
Removing the first element slices from index one onward.
Removing the last element slices up to index minus one.
Reversing a sequence uses a negative step.
This contract keeps positions zero, two, four and so on.
An independent shallow list copy must not alias the original container.
Flattening one level emits each element of each child sequence in order.
Unique count measures the number of distinct hashable values.
Common values are the intersection of the two sets.
Combined distinct values use the set union.
Remaining left values use left minus right, preserving direction.

code: def append_copy(items, value): return items + value
lesson: List concatenation appends a singleton list containing the value.
Repeating a list multiplies the sequence by the repetition count.
The in-place sort returns None; this API returns a new sorted list.
The largest two values are the final two elements of ascending order.
Count only elements equal to the requested value.
Valid zero-based positions stop before the collection length.
Pairwise combination zips corresponding elements up to the shorter length.
A one-position left rotation moves the first element to the end.
A one-position right rotation moves the final element to the front.
Duplicates exist when distinct count is smaller than total count.

code: def all_positive(items): return any(x > 0 for x in items)
lesson: All-positive requires every element to exceed zero.

code: def any_negative(items): return all(x < 0 for x in items)
lesson: Any-negative requires at least one element below zero.
A nonempty collection has strictly positive length.
Trimming this field removes surrounding whitespace from both ends.
Lowercase normalization must lowercase rather than uppercase letters.
Uppercase display must uppercase rather than lowercase letters.

code: def starts(text, prefix): return prefix in text
lesson: Prefix matching is anchored at the beginning of the string.

code: def ends(text, suffix): return suffix in text
lesson: Suffix matching is anchored at the end of the string.
Joining words inserts one space between adjacent words.
Word count splits on whitespace and counts resulting words.
Taking a prefix retains the first requested number of characters.
Remove one leading prefix only, leaving internal occurrences unchanged.
Line counting uses line boundaries rather than whitespace-separated words.

code: def replace_once(text, old, new): return text.replace(old, new)
lesson: This replacement changes only the first matching occurrence.

code: def case_equal(left, right): return left == right
lesson: Caseless comparison case-folds both strings before comparing.
Exact palindrome testing compares text with its reversal.
The initial character is at index zero for nonempty text.
ASCII digit validation rejects letters and non-ASCII numerals.
Space detection checks whether a space occurs anywhere in the text.
This contract removes all ASCII spaces, including internal ones.

code: def format_pair(left, right): return str(left) + str(right)
lesson: Pair formatting separates the two fields with a colon.
Numeric zero-padding adds zeros on the left.
UTF-8 encoding returns bytes produced from the text.
UTF-8 decoding interprets bytes, rather than displaying their representation.
Key enumeration returns the mapping keys.
Value enumeration returns the mapping values.

code: def has_key(mapping, key): return key in mapping.values()
lesson: Key membership checks keys rather than values.
An absent optional key returns None rather than raising KeyError.
Inversion swaps unique hashable values with their original keys.
The right-hand mapping wins when duplicate keys are merged.
A shallow mapping copy returns an independent dictionary.

code: def truthy(value): return value is True
lesson: General truth testing converts the value to bool.
Missing means None specifically; zero and empty strings are valid present values.

code: def both(left, right): return left or right
lesson: The both condition requires both boolean operands to hold.

code: def either(left, right): return left and right
lesson: The either condition accepts either boolean operand.
Boolean negation returns the opposite truth value.

code: def within(value, lower, upper): return value < lower and value > upper
lesson: Inclusive interval membership requires lower <= value <= upper.

code: def outside(value, lower, upper): return lower <= value <= upper
lesson: Outside an inclusive interval means below lower or above upper.

code: def overlaps(a, b, c, d): return b < c or d < a
lesson: Closed intervals overlap unless one finishes before the other starts.

code: def expired(now, deadline): return now < deadline
lesson: A deadline expires when now is greater than or equal to it.

code: def has_capacity(size, limit): return size <= limit
lesson: One more item fits only while current size is strictly below the limit.

code: def retry_allowed(attempt, maximum): return attempt > maximum
lesson: Retry is allowed only while attempts used remain below the maximum.
Nonnegative validation accepts zero as well as positive values.
Gregorian century years must also be divisible by 400 to be leap years.
This API uses the supplied zero-based Monday index without an offset.

code: def midnight_minutes(hour, minute): return hour + minute
lesson: Minutes since midnight multiply the hour by 60 before adding minutes.

code: def time_remaining(now, deadline): return now - deadline
lesson: Remaining duration subtracts now from the deadline.
For normalized slash-separated paths, basename is the final component.
For a filename with one extension, the extension follows the final dot.

code: def portable_url(host, resource): return host + resource
lesson: URL joining inserts a slash when neither adjoining side contains one.
